name: Decode Rot-Script
text: Make sense of corrupted signage, old warning glyphs, or a garbled broadcast.

name: Recall Old Maps
text: Pull a pre-collapse map from memory to find a shortcut or a hazard.

name: Read the Machine
text: Read a dying piece of tech well enough to guess what it still wants to do.

name: Jury-Rig a Fix
text: Patch something broken together with what's on hand, just long enough.

name: Overclock Salvage
text: Push a scavenged system past its limits for one big result.

name: Slip the Wreckage
text: Thread a tight, unstable gap without setting anything off.

name: Pick Rusted Lock
text: Work a stuck mechanism open with patience and a steady hand.

name: Dodge the Debris
text: React fast when the ceiling, floor, or wall stops cooperating.

name: Quickdraw Blade
text: Get a weapon into play before the other side reacts.

name: Vault the Wall
text: A full-body, no-hesitation move across a gap that shouldn't be crossable.

name: Read the Wind
text: Trust the gut feeling that something's about to go wrong.

name: Grit Through Rads
text: Push through a hazard your body really doesn't want to be in.

name: Mentor's Lesson
text: "Everything still wants to work. You just have to ask it right."

name: The Forest Warned
text: Every hair on her arms stood up an hour before the rot-storm hit.

name: Outrun the Drones
text: She still remembers exactly which alley had no cameras.

name: Steady Hands
text: Steady hands, sharp eyes.

name: Rusted Choir Rite
text: A half-remembered scavenger's prayer, said over broken tech.

name: Grapple-Rig
text: Scavenged rope and a bent hook, more reliable than it looks.

name: Stubborn Resolve
text: She's not leaving until this is done.

name: Whatever It Takes
text: Improvise. No plan survives contact anyway.
